priorityList: Use offensive trinkets and potions during Avenging Wrath or when Execution Sentence is active.
Cast Execution Sentence if Avenging Wrath is active (or Radiant Glory is talented) and Wake of Ashes is ready.
Cast Avenging Wrath on cooldown, ideally when Expurgation is ticking if talented into Holy Flames.
Cast Hammer of Light if its free proc is about to expire or if Avenging Wrath is active.
Cast Wake of Ashes if Avenging Wrath is active or on cooldown (>6s), or always if Radiant Glory is talented.
Cast Templar's Verdict (or Divine Storm if Empyrean Power is active) if at 5 Holy Power.
Cast Divine Toll on cooldown, ideally when Avenging Wrath is active.
Cast Blade of Justice if Art of War or Righteous Cause triggers.
Cast Hammer of Light as your primary finisher when available.
Cast Templar's Verdict (or Divine Storm if Empyrean Power is active) to spend Holy Power.
Cast Hammer of Wrath whenever available.
Cast Blade of Justice to generate Holy Power.
Cast Judgment to generate Holy Power.
Cast Templar Strike and Templar Slash to generate Holy Power.
Cast Crusader Strike if no other generators are available.
